qualification: Source registration/evidence available where listed; inspect source before claiming exact 3D reconstruction

surface.qualification: Coarse source-masked two-face own-cell corner receiver. Existing editor height rule declares rise2/lift128, exact two downhill face directions and own-cell upper support; all four current original pivots/scales retained. G21 reuses exactly matching G13 plane records; G14/G20 use their declared opposite corner pattern with the same existing G12/G13 own-cell extent X/Z[-.5,.5] and upper H2 convention. Source-only fragments and gaps remain exact. Beyond nominal own-cell planes, explicit closest-plane extensions are counted without clipping. This is a coarse receiving proxy, not measured rock thickness, facet depth or vendor source camera. No blocking volume, new terrain/support cells or seamless adjacency certificate.
